text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wasn't yawnin'! That was a shout to 
fire myself up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! Last night, Oguri suddenly 
started watchin' a horror movie out of 
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was totally fine, though. If 
anything, I'm way stronger than a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why, not at all... It's not like I 
couldn't sleep or anything... *yawn*.
